description.text: The second expansion pack of the Pocket Monsters Card Game, released in Japan on 5 March 1997. Its theme is the Safari Zone, so it gathers the Pokémon found there, many of them Grass type, and its only Trainer card is Poké Ball. Its rare cards are all holos. The English Jungle followed in June 1999 and printed each of them a second time without the holo, doubling the rares.
